items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: At that time, Nicholas Gangliano in New Orleans was managing the band... So it was up to me to go out and find some other places for the band to play... Nick went, uh, was starting in law school about then. He had them booked on a, um, college concert tour, uh, and was himself not able to go, and as

ctx.x: Testing, testing. I'll be glad when you're dead. That's right. Those were lost, I'm afraid. They were just given to Kate Howard. They went. Bill Russell never intended to do anything with them. Yes, but there aren't very many old man Moses. That's right. There aren't many of those. I'll show you the ones where we were talking about yesterday, the Bakersfield thing. Yeah. We don't have the exact date. I don't either. You don't have the exact date? I'll make it September 1954. That's the closest I can come to it.…
